title: Aftermath and Radiators
author: Juniper Oyelaran
blurb: Xanthe Amberdale, a restaurant critic who has forgotten how food tastes, has perfected the smile that ends conversations. But when a stranger at the funeral knows the family by a name nobody uses, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must translate the untranslatable sentence and live with it, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
